# brig sandbox snapshot delete

Delete snapshots

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox snapshot delete [VM] SNAPSHOT... [-w W]
```

Also: `brig sandbox snapshot rm`.

## Description

Delete the snapshots named SANDBOX@TIME in the workspace of -w or
BRIG\_WORKSPACE. What a snapshot shares with its sandbox or other snapshots
stays theirs; [`brig sandbox snapshot list`](brig-sandbox-snapshot-list.md) shows what deleting it frees.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox snapshot delete dev webapp@2026-10-14T15:02:11Z
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
